Product Details
Men’s Gordon Modern tartan jacket featuring a classic 3-roll-2 silhouette, three patch pockets, and house buttons in brass. Made from 100% English wool woven by Abraham Moon & Sons and cut to the original 1852 blazer pattern.
3-roll-2 silhouette. Three patch pockets. Interior welt pocket. Quarter-inch topstitch swelled seam finishing. Lined sleeves. Rowing Blazers house buttons in brass. Four-button cuffs. 100% English wool. Includes handmade cloisonné buttonhole fob.
Care instructions: Dry clean only.
Size & Fit
Cut to the original 1852 blazer pattern. For specific measurements, refer to the size chart.
Height: 5'11.5"
Waist: 32"
Suit: 40R
Inseam: 32"
Provenance
The Gordon tartan is the regimental tartan of the famed Gordon Highlanders, and is based on the iconic Black Watch military tartan. The sett was selected by Alexander Gordon, 4th Duke of Gordon, from three samples submitted by weaver and outfitter William Forsyth. Said Forsyth: “When I had the honor of communing with His Grace the Duke of Gordon, he was desirous to have patterns of the 42nd Regiment plaid with a small yellow stripe properly placed. I imagine the yellow stripes will appear very lively.”

p-ledbury-7169344962746.d:
Inspired by fall foliage in the mountains just west of Richmond, the Hartmann is a fall all-star. Brushed on both sides for softness inside and out, this midweight twill has a depth of color variation you rarely find in a flannel. The blend is what sets it apart: cotton for breathability and that familiar flannel hand, viscose for a fluid drape that keeps the shirt from ever feeling stiff or boxy, and a touch of polyester so it holds its shape season after season — no bagging at the elbows, no sagging hem by March. The result is a shirt that looks as sharp tucked in with chinos as it does layered open over a t-shirt. Now offered in three warm shades: the original Apricot, a deeper Hickory, and a versatile Soft Brown.
Premium Flannel
This apricot flannel shirt delivers exceptional softness and warmth. The brushed mid-weight twill fabric is full of color variation, creating depth and visual interest that makes each shirt unique. The blend of 60% cotton, 20% viscose, and 20% polyester ensures durability while maintaining that oh-so-soft feel against your skin.
Perfect for Cool, Crisp Days

Previously known as our Union Work Pants, now renamed the Anvil Work Pants. Same fit, same durability.
Even a simple man can appreciate a few bells-and-whistles sometimes, which is why we doubled down on the layering of the knee panels and ankle cuffs on these badass britches. The Anvil Work Pants are the legit heavy workhorse pants you've been looking for. Deep pockets in both the front and back, a perfectly placed utility pocket for extra storage on the right leg, and you’ve got an undisputed workhorse in your wardrobe that will fit better-and-better as you break them in.
THE SPECS + DETAILS:
• 14oz 100% cotton duck canvas
• Double-layered front thigh-to-knee panels
• Custom I&R rivets on all pockets and critical stress points
• Shank button waistband + YKK zippered fly
• Double needle felled rise, back yoke, and outseam
• Utility pocket on right leg
• Double layered rear ankle cuff for extra durability
• D-ring key clip on the right side
• 33" inseam
